At stage 5, schedule a reliable skill. Start with drafts for human review. Add tools or connectors when the job needs fresh data. It works just like Fusion 360, where you sketch shapes, add dimensions, and push geometry to build solids. The coolest part is the AI integration. You can plug in an AI agent, and it will drive the software to design parts, check measurements, and even take screenshots of its work. It is built in Rust to be fast and stable. It is a free alternative to expensive CAD software. It is a great tool for anyone who wants to make 3D printed parts or prototypes.
